updates.item: Theorem B (Maass-Selberg positivity iff Nevanlinna), Theorem C (closure under Blaschke factors), control BLS
updates.outcome: holds in rank one; one sentence in a narrower form
updates.narrowerForm: Zeros may be inserted at non-real conjugate pairs and at real points with even multiplicity; a single real factor is not covered (Im N' = q a N (N + a)/|.|^2 changes sign). Everything about the affine kernel (I_aff) is argued or relative to unopened sources: closure of (I_aff) under M -> M Theta is OPEN; the affine Maass-Selberg relation, the argument census (Lemmas A1 to A3), convergence in the Tits cone and the degenerate Whittaker formula are relative to Garland and FKP read through summaries. BLS is a control for rank-one truncated-norm positivity only.

section 3.3 (b) parenthesis (c = -2.1, single real factors): MEASURED only
'the inequality carries no constraint on numerator zeros': proved for (I); OPEN for (I_aff)
updates.checks: Theorem B identity 2.3e-55 on 80 random triples; Theorem C re-derived; BLS a = 0.9+14.5i: zero at a, unimodular, gamma form, Im N >= 0 on 960 points and Gram matrices positive at x = 0, 0.5, 1 (also two pairs, T-NR q = 2, 3); anti-control M/Theta, -M and x < 0 fail

updates.item: kernel factorisation (F*(s)/F*(w)) x target-independent factor; orbit under symmetric multipliers (Lemma M); Lemma T
updates.narrowerForm: Exact for the kernel H_- of BRS (4.6). For H_+ the source subtracts alpha^+_(1,1/2)(s/2) (not identically zero: value -2 at s = 0), so H_+ = (zeta*(s)/zeta*(w)) x [A^+ - alpha^+_1(s/2) zeta*(w)]/2: the second factor contains the target additively. Lemma M (i)-(iv) holds for both kernels as a statement about H G(s)/G(w); 'the kernel of F = zeta G is the orbit point' holds for H_- only. Lemma T holds for the H_- family; in the H_+ family the coefficient at the lowest frequency m = q^2 is 0. 'The target enters by division' (the filter) stands.
